description: Interior view of patio entrance; two closed slatted wooden doors, a viga beamed ceiling with a hanging light bulb, attached to the adobe wall to the left  are enormous elk antlers attached to a skull in partial shadow. Below is an adobe bench with boxes of rocks, one of which says Budweiser on the side, stacked tree stumps, and piles of stacked wood on the opposite wall.
title: Patio Door, Abiquiu House
